description: Parkings ADBM is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SA Aéroport de Bordeaux Mérignac. Ce jeu de données répond aux spécifications du schéma “Lieux de stationnement” disponible sur le site schema.data.gouv.fr. Il comprend les données des parkings exploités par SA ADBM. Coverage: SA Aéroport de Bordeaux Mérignac. The publisher named on the listing is SA Aéroport de Bordeaux Mérignac. Its keywords include place-de-stationnement, bordeaux, merignac, place-de-parking, parking. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-07-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
